item.title: Anbernic RG DDS: Dual‑Screen Handheld Nears $300
item.description: Anbernic's RG DDS launches at $299.99, offering a Snapdragon G2 Gen 2, Android 16, dual 1080p screens and AI button, redefining premium handheld gaming.

item.title: Steam Deck 2 Leak: AMD Gainsborough Chip for Handheld
item.description: New AMD Gainsborough APU, spotted in a driver leak, may finally give Valve the generational performance jump needed for a Steam Deck 2 handheld.

item.title: Acer Dual Play Mini: Handheld Gaming Turns Laptop
item.description: Acer’s Project Dual Play Mini, unveiled at IFA 2026, flips into a compact laptop, blending Predator performance, 50‑year legacy, and Atlas 8 cooling.

item.title: ASUS ROG XBOX Ally X20 Launch Marks 20‑Year Milestone
item.description: ASUS marks ROG’s 20th anniversary with the XBOX Ally X20 handheld, now with a 7.4‑inch HDR OLED display, sleek chassis and an AR‑glass bundle option.

item.title: Asus Xbox Ally X20 Handheld Now Pre‑Orderable Solo
item.description: Asus now lets you pre‑order the $1,300 Xbox Ally X20 handheld alone, shipping Oct 15, ending the AR‑glasses bundle and featuring a gold‑trim chassis.
